title: Helpful Response Sort
body_markdown:
# Helpful Response Sort

Sort each card into Helpful, Harmful, or Needs More Context.

- I am here with you.
- This must be your fault.
- What practical help would be useful?
- I know exactly what God is doing.
- Choices can have consequences.
- You do not have to explain private details to me.
- We can pray, lament, and seek help.
